name: FRIENDSHIP DAY
tagline: a little walk for your best friend
description: Scroll and a little bird walks you both through a valley — flowers, your playlist, polaroids, chocolates, and the things you never said out loud.

fields.label: Opening lines
fields.default:
hi saj, you know what's today?
30 july — friendship day.
so i built you a little walk. come on.

fields.label: Your own song (upload an audio file)
Sign 1 — the flowers
fields.default:
flowers, because you turn ordinary tuesdays
into whole occasions.

fields.label: Sign 2 — the playlist
fields.default:
our playlist is 90% chaos, 10% crying —
hit the sign, you know the one.

fields.label: Sign 3 — the polaroids
fields.default: proof we were here, being ridiculous.

fields.label: Sign 4 — the bubbles
fields.default:
and a few things i never said out loud.
tap a bubble.

fields.label: Bubble 1 — message
fields.default: you make ordinary days feel like the good part of the movie. thank you for every single one.

fields.label: Bubble 2 — message
fields.default: if today is heavy — text me. i'll drop everything, bring snacks, and say nothing till you want me to.

fields.label: Bubble 3 — message
fields.default: i don't say it enough: you are my favourite person. happy friendship day ♥
